cliff-edge.speaker: Narrator
cliff-edge.text: Cool wind rushes across a high cliff edge. Below, lantern-lit streets wind toward a towering castle against a twilight sky.

awakening-gaze.speaker: Adventurer
awakening-gaze.text: A castle and a bustling town... so much beyond the quiet fields I know. Every road down there feels like a story waiting to begin.

call-of-the-horizon.speaker: Narrator
call-of-the-horizon.text: The distant bells chime like a summons. Even in a dream, your pulse quickens toward the unknown.
